title: Nourishing Middle Eastern Brown Rice Pilaf
description: A roasted, dense, and energizing Middle Eastern dish featuring brown rice, this pilaf is smoke-hot and vegetarian-friendly, cooked to perfection in a banana leaf vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, rinse the brown rice and soak it in water for 30 minutes.
In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chopped carrots and zucchini and cook until they are tender.
Drain the soaked brown rice and add it to the pan, stirring to combine with the vegetables and oil.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Spoon the rice mixture onto a banana leaf, folding the leaf to form a packet.
Bake the packet in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.
Remove the packet from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
